hook: A pure Rust GIS ships 300 pull requests

beats.say: RustGIS is a free, open-source GIS written in pure Rust that runs on Windows, macOS, Linux and in the browser, with data staying on your machine.
Version 0.8.0 brings together more than 300 pull requests from 20 contributors, and keeps every layer in its own coordinate system.
It adds picture markers, charts and curved labels in layouts, new formats like GRIB and GeoPDF, and an AI assistant that can look at the map.
